andromeda_origins.gameplay.desc: Server-authoritative Origin and power configuration. Changes apply live unless a setting explicitly says otherwise.

Configure each standard Andromeda Origin independently.
andromeda_origins.gameplay.overgrownOrig: Overgrown Defaults
Configure Overgrown's built-in Origins. The master switch defaults off.
Enable Stock Overgrown Origins
Master switch. OFF hides all built-in Overgrown Origins; ON allows the individual switches below to decide availability.

andromeda_origins.gameplay.blockIncapaci: Prevent golden apples, enchanted golden apples, and golden carrots from resetting Incapacitated down counters or reviving players. Normal food effects, modded foods, and Origin revival abilities still work. Server setting; applies immediately.
andromeda_origins.gameplay.foodBalance.d: Server-wide food balance. Settings apply immediately. Let's Do mods remain optional.
Block Farmer's Blessing and clear it from players within one second.
Block Grandma's Blessing and clear it from players within one second.
Block Stoutheart and clear it from players within one second.
andromeda_origins.gameplay.foodBalance.b: Override Beef Wellington nutrition and saturation for held food and placed dishes. Turn off to restore upstream values.
Hunger points per serving, 0–20. Two points equal one hunger icon. Default: 6.
Restored saturation equals nutrition × modifier × 2. Default: 0.5, restoring 6 saturation at 6 nutrition.
andromeda_origins.gameplay.logoutDiagnos: Log bounded entity-unload caller stacks to investigate logout crashes. Server option; OP level 2. Applies immediately without restart or JVM arguments. Fabric only. Collects evidence; does not prevent crashes.
